result.topic_en: Bare calculations on series expansions of an elliptic-type integral via hypergeometric (P-function) representations, and algebraic inequalities in a, b, c with perturbation quantities λ, μ, δg, δh related to stability of the rotating fluid ellipsoid.

methods.what: Series expansion of the potential integral in powers of alpha using derivatives of an auxiliary function f(beta)
Binomial expansion of inverse square root
Derivatives of f expressed as integrals
Representation of the integral as a Riemann P-function (hypergeometric) and its power series
Change of variables to symmetric/antisymmetric perturbation coordinates lambda, mu
